# Local A-Frame runtime

`aframe-1.2.0.min.js` was downloaded without modification from <https://aframe.io/releases/1.2.0/aframe.min.js>. This is the same A-Frame version used by the upstream prototype. The MIT license is preserved in `AFRAME-LICENSE.txt`, downloaded from the project's v1.2.0 tag.

B1 loads this local copy. No CDN access is required to load its engine, panorama, coordinate data or audio. Other original scenes still use their original external dependencies.
